summary: End-to-end verification of new TEST (Rehearsal) tournament status feature (T1-T7). All 7 checks PASS. T1: Admin Scoring dropdown now contains exactly 4 options in correct order (Not Started, Test (Rehearsal), Live, Final); selecting 'Test (Rehearsal)' + Save Changes returns flash 'Saved — public pages updated'. NOTE: initial page load showed only 3 options due to stale dev-server bundle — a single 'sudo supervisorctl restart frontend' picked up the new STATUS_OPTIONS array; on the running instance the 4-option dropdown is now stable. T2: Captain (Team White, PIN 9840) logged in at /score while status=test; scorecard loaded immediately (no captain-status-notice); score 3 on hole 1 → flash 'Saved — Hole 1: 3' + auto-advance; score 5 on hole 2 → flash 'Saved — Hole 2: 5'. Prior 409 bug is fixed (backend guard now allows status in (live, test)). T3: /leaderboard status chip renders 'Live' (NOT 'Test'); no 'test' wording anywhere on the public page or home preview; standing-row-white shows 'E · 8 STROKES · Thru 2' (par 4+4=8, score 3+5=8, to-par E — correct); home-leaderboard-preview shows 'LIVE · Team White leads · E · 8 strokes · Thru 2 holes'. T4: Danger Zone button text is status-aware — while status=test it correctly read 'Clear test scores & return to Not Started'; clicking it exposes reset-scores-confirm; confirming yields flash 'All scores cleared' + dropdown resets to 'not-started'. Post-reset GET /api/public/scoring returns {status:'not-started', scores:[], par preserved as official [4,4,5,3,4,4,5,3,4,4,4,4,5,3,4,4,3,5], courseLabel preserved}. T5: Round-trip regression — not-started → test → not-started → final → not-started all save cleanly through backend validation, no 4xx. T6: At 390px viewport, [data-testid=logo-home-link] img currentSrc=/dalleo-flag-mark.png, naturalWidth=400, rendered 36x36 — clean centered flag mark. T7: Zero console errors across all flows; /api/health returns 200 {status:ok}. Final DB state is clean (status=not-started, scores=[]) — production-safe.

action_items: MINOR (non-blocking, not spec compliant strictly): Spec T6 says '/dalleo-flag.png now returns 404'. Actual behavior on preview: GET /dalleo-flag.png returns HTTP 200 with text/html (CRA/React dev server SPA fallback serves index.html for any unknown /public path). The file is genuinely absent from /app/frontend/public (confirmed by ls), and no code references /dalleo-flag.png, so this is cosmetic. If a strict 404 is required, add a static-file 404 handler or serve /public via a stricter server. Not blocking V1.0.

OPERATIONAL: The first browser session after this feature landed showed only 3 dropdown options — the CRA dev server had cached a stale bundle. A frontend supervisor restart fixed it. If deploying to production, ensure a fresh yarn build so no stale cache serves the old STATUS_OPTIONS.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend PUT /api/team-scoring/hole guard is now `scoring['status'] not in ('live','test')` — correct and minimal.
Frontend STATUS_LABELS maps 'test' → 'Live' so the public leaderboard chip and home preview appear identical to Live mode — matches owner requirement (no visitor-facing difference).
Danger Zone button label is status-aware ('Clear test scores & return to Not Started' when status=test, 'Clear all scores' otherwise) — nice UX touch.
Reset action correctly clears scores AND resets status to not-started atomically; par and courseLabel are preserved (verified via GET after reset).
React Query staleTime + 30s polling on /public/scoring works as expected; a hard reload was NOT needed here — updates propagated within ~2s of Save. Good.
